topic: clear a paper jam inside a printer
core_question: How do I safely remove jammed paper from inside a printer? (secondary: How do I stop a car's brakes from squealing when I press the pedal?)
answer_summary: Power off, open all access panels/trays, and slowly pull the jammed sheet in the direction of the paper path (not backward) to avoid tearing it.; after the topic shift: Remove the wheel and caliper, take out the worn/thin brake pads (often down to the wear indicator causing the squeal), and install new pads, lubricating the caliper slides as needed.
